name: cap-event-microservices
description: Backend for cap-event-ui: api-gateway + auth-service (fake OneLogin / OIDC). Each folder is an independent Nest project; this file only provides convenience scripts.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix contracts && npm install --prefix auth-service && npm install --prefix api-gateway && npm install --prefix e2e
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix auth-service && npm run build --prefix api-gateway
scripts.lint: npm run lint:check --prefix auth-service && npm run lint:check --prefix api-gateway
scripts.test: npm test --prefix auth-service && npm test --prefix api-gateway
